name: Pipeliners - Guardian Audit 4 Blogs 2026-10-08
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Rollup of an "SEO Compliance & Quality Guardian" audit of four blog posts (Oct 8 to 9, 2026, read-only) and the detailed change list that followed. Evidence: live HTML as desktop and Googlebot smartphone, GSC URL Inspection, 3 months of GSC data, WordPress post data. Google Ads ad check not run (token expired). Findings are labelled G-Policy, G-Tech, BP (best practice) or Client (house rule).

# Key findings
- No spam-policy issues on any page; self-canonicals, one H1 and one meta each; FAQ schema matches visible FAQs; tel links untouched.
- /repair-sewer-line-without-digging/: not indexed (crawled Oct 7); duplicates the intent of /trenchless-sewer-repair/. "Pipeliners USA" 4 times and "pipe lining" as a noun 16 times. Review required.
- /14-warning-signs-your-sewer-pipes-may-be-leaking/: indexed, best of the four (333 impressions, position 62.6), focus "sewer line leak" aligned, claims verified. Pass; recheck around Nov 5.
- /signs-of-outdated-sewer-drain-pipes/: 5,555 words of generic bulk-import text; critical service accuracy issue (describes pipe bursting, not offered), unverified warranty and "leader" claims, basements. Fails as is.
- /5-signs-you-need-to-repipe-your-home-in-arizona/: OTTO schema says "Repiping Services" (critical); dash in an H2; "here!" links. Fails as is.

# Decisions and status
- Detailed change list (Oct 9) gives exact now and proposed text for each item, with a backup, guarded write and desktop plus Googlebot check required before anything goes live.
- Superseded points (Oct 9): "transferable" warranty wording is verified and stays; the merge direction reversed, so /trenchless-sewer-repair/ merges INTO /repair-sewer-line-without-digging/ (blogs must not target "trenchless sewer repair"). Follow-up drafts live in `blog-drafts/guardian-fixes-2026-10-09/` (owned by the blogs notes).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `Guardian-Audit-4-Blogs-2026-10-08.md`: the audit.
- `Detailed-Change-List-2026-10-09.md`: exact edits.
- `live/`: article text, structure and full text dumps of the 4 posts plus /trenchless-sewer-repair/; `crawl.json`; Python scripts.
